# Target-run JSON fixture provenance

`run-json-source-v1.json` was generated from the pinned cn-tool 0.8.0 source at
commit `2e2f3c40ef6718486f1ca4477f9145029ec495fa`. The test-only generator
checks that Git revision and the exact SHA-256 of each source file before it
extracts and executes any source AST:

- `cn_tool/modules/ping_monitor.py`: `268543bcc9e38026cc5502821f5cfeceaa9015d9fef745829ddc01d517e82396`
- `cn_tool/utils/config_history.py`: `24565c496b3c77ee11b823c336990a44875b66471fb93ba08ea67f877d4d4568`
- `cn_tool/utils/render.py`: `8fbac4b6cd906108537d7abfe812a6a41e0d32234caa938b3457f7f80923e152`

The generator extracts and executes `PingMonitorModule._sections`, `_seen_rows`,
and `_summary_row` (ping_monitor.py lines 601–654), `_when`/`_day` (lines
95–100), `format_time` (config_history.py line 76), and `snake_key`/`_render_json`
(render.py lines 40–60). It supplies a fixed model fixture without importing
the cn-tool package or running probes, storage, configuration, or networking.

Reproduce with Python 3.12.14 using the verified checkout path:

```sh
python3 internal/output/testdata/generate_source_golden.py --source-root /tmp/cn-tool-review.zoO7Ym/repo
```

The bounded generator writes only `run-json-source-v1.json`. The recorded
fixture SHA-256 is
`dc3327122d1c4855bb450a5c1be34250c377fa46c4a8cc0f1260e769dded6cc6`.

The target-run composition follows source `_cli_run` (ping_monitor.py lines
406–454): input rejections remain in admission order, then never-resolved names
are sorted and appended with `no such host`. The fixture's interval is a numeric
float, matching the reviewed native M4 contract and source JSON behavior. The
golden covers HTML/non-ASCII/quoted text, sparse latest rows, sampled periods,
and TCP field order. Low-year timestamp padding is separately specified and
tested as a native extension.

`run-human-source-v1.csv` and `run-human-source-v1.md` are generated by
`generate_human_goldens.py` with Python 3.12.14. It verifies the same pinned
cn-tool revision and every consulted source hash, then extracts and executes
`PingMonitorModule._sections`, `_seen_rows`, `_summary_row`, `ping_history.py`
`online_text`/`_clock`, `ping_monitor.py` `_when`/`_day`/`_span`, and
`render.py` `_render_csv`/`_render_md` plus `display.py` `table_columns`.
Thus section membership/heading union, `N of M rounds`, interval, UTC period
date rendering, CSV quoting, Markdown escaping, and final newlines come from
the pinned semantic composition and renderer rather than a hand-built expected
CSV/Markdown string. The fixture supplies only deterministic tracker/request
values and imports no cn-tool package or Rich runtime.

The additional source hashes are `display.py`:
`866df6d40446b10b1965bd6ba1e12af4b8cdcd05a383a451a537a28e07049435` and
`ping_history.py`:
`d491678b240f23d26a2673951ba293eabff3a992d2840bbc1219a63ec31a89bf`, plus
`color_schemes.py`:
`792748e8d91dad83e1870a877b6e242152e2f7efdc5e3d5fc8b47ad1ffe6a42d`.

Reproduce with:

```sh
python3.12 internal/output/testdata/generate_human_goldens.py --source-root /tmp/cn-tool-review.zoO7Ym/repo
```

The generated UTF-8/LF files have SHA-256
`2549a365c19d699a672fa2cd9f4e7ea46ebd677702914f8a7e7b8aa6d01b716f` (CSV)
and `a4347cbd3e681057cf95736d73fabc308dc2389a153da578937c8f15e0de71f3`
(Markdown). Their nested `.gitattributes` entries disable text conversion so
the byte-exact source fixtures keep LF on Windows checkouts.
`theme-source-v1.json` records the source's four title/column palette values
and role order; SHA-256:
`b4ff68554356b59bfc6e0d97df0919747fecf23622be3609c2829ff3a153e5c9`.

The same generator extracts `_Run._header` and its `_clock`, `_span`, `_slots`,
and `_fit_parts` helpers to characterize the scheduled completed-round number
versus the in-flight round number and comma-grouped progress. It also executes
the source `ping_grid.compact_lines` function for a deterministic 1,024-cell
case. `live-header-source-v1.json` records those source-produced semantic
phrases (`round 1`, `round 1: 0 of 1,024 pinged`,
`round 2: 300 of 1,024 pinged`, and `Hosts: 1,024 .`); its SHA-256 is
`e7387088b2496896ededf069f2957ecc763e087dd5bae7bf8b1324e0df13b880`.
The generator verifies `ping_grid.py` at SHA-256
`61c08796c0375071173dd080060c8c819693eb2a9c659e0d1503d908656fbfd5`. This
fixture is also pinned to LF via `.gitattributes`.
